Title: Valid login
Preconditions: Valid demo user credentials are available
Steps: Enter valid username and password; select Login

Title: Invalid password
Steps: Enter valid username and incorrect password; select Login
Expected Result: A clear authentication error is displayed and login is not completed

Title: Locked-out account
Preconditions: Current demo credentials for a locked-out test account are confirmed
Steps: Enter the documented locked-out account credentials; select Login
Expected Result: Access is denied with an appropriate message

Title: Product list loads
Expected Result: Product names, images, and prices are visible without a blocking error

Title: Open product details
Preconditions: User is on the product list
Steps: Open a product detail page; return to the list
Expected Result: Selected product details are displayed and navigation returns correctly

Title: Add one product
Preconditions: User is on the product list
Steps: Add one product to the cart
Expected Result: Cart indicator updates and the selected product appears in the cart

Title: Remove product
Steps: Remove the product from the cart
Expected Result: Product is removed and cart state updates accordingly

Title: Continue shopping
Expected Result: User returns to the product list and can continue browsing

Title: Required information validation
Preconditions: User is logged in and cart contains an item
Steps: Start checkout; leave a required field blank; continue
Expected Result: The form prevents progression and communicates the validation issue

Title: Order summary
Preconditions: User is logged in and cart contains an item
Steps: Complete required customer information and continue
Expected Result: Checkout overview shows the expected item and displayed totals

Title: Complete demo order
Preconditions: Checkout overview is displayed with a valid cart

Title: Logout
Expected Result: User returns to the login page and protected pages are no longer directly accessible in the current session
